title: A credential shared with another person's estate, fabric-peer-share-envelope/1 (DEC-0142)
description: HPKE (RFC 9180) base mode, suite [16, 1, 1], to the recipient's share #kem, info the ASCII fabric-peer-share-envelope/1, the RFC 8785 bytes of the header the additional data; signed ES256 over the RFC 8785 bytes of {header, ct} by the sender's share #sig. The header names the share, the slot and the provider, never the value; it lives at most 90 days (checkPeerShareEnvelope). docs/specification/peer-share.md#the-envelope.

recipient.description: The RFC 7638 thumbprint of the recipient's share #kem.

signer.description: The RFC 7638 thumbprint of the sender's share #sig.

slot.description: The credential's slot name, never its value.

iat.description: An RFC 3339 instant in UTC, ending in Z, as the relay family reads it.

exp.description: An RFC 3339 instant in UTC, ending in Z, as the relay family reads it.

enc.description: The HPKE encapsulated key, unpadded base64url.

sig.description: ES256 over the RFC 8785 bytes of {header, ct}, raw r || s, low-S, unpadded base64url.
